reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard pattern with a sibling guard and calls it from every link function.

duplication.why: The closed check is defined once; only the one-line call is repeated across the six provider functions, as the tree already does for the existing guard.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the existing pre-link guard and runs before any side effect.

scope.why: Only the new guard, its six call sites and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: Simple and consistent, though a future provider must remember to call two guards since there is no shared link sequence.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account functions (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking, Fintegra).
